query:
-- Detalhes das compras do Galão 1
SELECT id, month_year, liters_purchased, ROUND(liters_purchased/100, 2) as liters_display, amount_paid, purchased_at, notes
FROM fuel_purchases
WHERE gallon_number = 1
ORDER BY purchased_at;

-- Detalhes dos abastecimentos ativos do Galão 1
SELECT id, client_name, boat_name, liters, ROUND(liters/100, 2) as liters_display, payment_status, asaas_payment_id, created_at
FROM fuel_records
WHERE gallon_number = 1 AND payment_status != 'cancelled'
ORDER BY created_at;

-- Verificar se há registros cancelados do Galão 1 (abastecimentos excluídos)
SELECT id, client_name, boat_name, liters, ROUND(liters/100, 2) as liters_display, payment_status, asaas_payment_id, created_at
FROM fuel_records
WHERE gallon_number = 1 AND payment_status = 'cancelled'
ORDER BY created_at;
